# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 26

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 026 — Mandate 1 (Believe in One God)
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 1 — "created and completed all things" vs. "created all things and brought them to completion"
- **EMET:** "created and completed all things"
- **LOGOS:** "created all things and brought them to completion"
- **PNEUMA:** "created everything and brought it all to completion"
- **Decision:** "created and brought all things to completion" — SOPHIA synthesis; the two actions are distinct

### 2. V. 1 — "made all things out of nothing to exist" vs. "brought all things into existence out of nothing"
- **EMET:** "made all things out of nothing to exist"
- **LOGOS:** "brought all things into existence out of nothing"
- **PNEUMA:** "made everything that exists out of nothing"
- **Decision:** "made all things out of nothing to exist" — the Greek ek tou mē ontos eis to einai is very specific; the double phrase (from non-being into being) should be preserved

### 3. V. 2 — "exercise self-control" vs. "practice self-control"
- **EMET:** "exercise self-control"
- **LOGOS:** "practice self-control"
- **PNEUMA:** "practice self-control"
- **Decision:** "exercise self-control" — enkrateia; the verb askeo used suggests deliberate practice/exercise

### 4. V. 2 — "throw off" vs. "cast off" vs. "strip wickedness right off"
- **EMET:** "throw off all wickedness"
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "cast off" / "strip off"
- **Decision:** "cast off all wickedness" — aporrhipsai = cast/throw off; "cast off" is more natural English for deliberate action

**Total disagreements: 4**
